description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git cvsexportcommit' tool, which exports commits from a Git repository to a CVS repository. It includes setup, multiple test cases for different scenarios (file creation, deletion, updates, handling of binary files, special characters, and permissions), and validation checks. The script uses test-lib.sh for test utilities and performs command-line operations to verify the functionality of the CVS export process.
